summary: Latest global AI updates refreshed from major frontier lab, policy, healthcare, and industry sources.

items.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.5
items.description: OpenAI released GPT-5.5, positioning it as a stronger model for coding, research, office work, computer use, and longer-running agentic tasks.

items.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT support for clinicians
items.description: OpenAI announced a clinician-focused ChatGPT offering for verified U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists, highlighting clinical documentation, care support, and research workflows.

items.title: Google centers enterprise AI strategy on agents
items.description: Google announced expanded enterprise AI products focused on custom agents, governance, security, Gemini Enterprise, upgraded Vertex AI, and new TPU infrastructure.

items.title: Google DeepMind publishes Decoupled DiLoCo work
items.description: Google DeepMind described Decoupled DiLoCo, a distributed training approach aimed at making AI training more resilient across separated compute clusters.

items.title: Workspace agents arrive in ChatGPT
items.description: OpenAI introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT for cloud-based automation of complex workflows across tools and team operations.

items.title: OpenAI introduces Privacy Filter
items.description: OpenAI released Privacy Filter, an open-weight model intended to detect and redact personally identifiable information in text.

items.title: Healthcare AI focus: FDA devices, state bills, clinical admin agents
items.description: Healthcare AI Digest highlighted FDA-authorized AI device growth, state policy attention to AI-driven insurance decisions, and funding around voice/chat agents for clinical administration.

items.title: CSIS tracks AI standards and policy activity in Asia
items.description: CSIS reported on regional AI policy developments, including China standards work around humanoid robots and embodied AI plus broader AI+ industrial planning.

items.title: U.S. AI policy framework emphasizes innovation, safety, and federal alignment
items.description: A March 2026 White House framework outlined nonbinding legislative recommendations on AI, including child safety, free speech, workforce readiness, innovation, and concerns about fragmented state regulation.

items.title: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Images 2.0
items.description: OpenAI introduced an updated image generation model with improved text rendering, multilingual support, and visual reasoning capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI scales Codex for enterprise software workflows
items.description: OpenAI announced enterprise Codex expansion with consulting partners and positioned Codex around software development lifecycle workflows.

items.title: Google DeepMind expands frontier AI partnerships
items.description: Google DeepMind announced partnerships with global consultancies to help organizations adopt frontier AI capabilities.
